effect_description_eng:
[Hand] [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (Your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may suspend up to 3 Digimon. For each of your opponent's Digimon suspended by this effect, gain 1 memory.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon becomes suspended, 1 of your Digimon gains ＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.) and gets +3000 DP until the end of your opponent's turn.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Ace Overflow ＜-4＞ (As this card moves from the field or under a card to an area other than those, lose 4 memory.)
